# Aniket Jamunde

> Aniket Jamunde designs and builds websites, mobile apps, e-commerce experiences, search programs and AI automation for growing businesses.

## Services
- Website development: fast, SEO-ready websites for businesses and brands
- App development: Android and iOS apps built with Flutter and modern web tech
- Game development
- SEO, AEO (answer engine optimization) and GEO (generative engine optimization)
- E-commerce and Shopify stores
- Ads optimization for Google and Meta campaigns
